stem: Which graph represents the relationship between x and y in the equation y = 3x?
visual_elements: Graph A: Cartesian plane from 0 to 6 on x and y axes with points at (3,1) and (6,2)
Graph B: Cartesian plane from 0 to 6 on x and y axes with points at (1,5) and (3,6)
Graph C: Cartesian plane from 0 to 6 on x and y axes with points at (1,3) and (2,6)
Graph D: Cartesian plane from 0 to 6 on x and y axes with points at (3,1), (3,3), and (3,6)
